record.body:
## Rationale

The link must live in `composer`, because `composer` imports `score` and not the reverse. A placement record per effort keeps `score:effort` free of a reference upward. The subject is the effort slug, so canon enforces one placement per effort. Moving an effort supersedes one record. The area record does not change when efforts come and go.

## Counter-argument

An `area` field on `score:effort` is one write and one read, with no new record type. The layering rule limits imports, not schema references, and ideas already reference `score:effort`. Engage would set the area in the same record that it creates for the effort. The placement record adds a type, a CLI command and a second lookup for the same fact.

payload.alternatives: efforts list on composer:area; area field on score:effort
payload.choice: A composer:placement record per effort, subject = effort slug, payload area
